title: Vampire Vape New York Cheesecake Flavour Concentrate 30ml
description: Recreate the smooth, creamy indulgence of an authentic New York Cheesecake with this simple-to-use flavour concentrate from Vampire Vape. Smooth, rich and with hints of buttery pastry and warm vanilla, this exquisite flavour is a treat by itself or with the addition of a fruity flavour concentrate from Vampire Vape’s range. Add to VG/PG DIY Mixing Products for optimum flavour. All Vampire Vape flavour concentrates are 100% PG based. Please note: This flavour concentrate is not intended to be vaped on its own. These concentrates are for personal use and are not to be used for commercial purposes. Details 100% PG Based Add to a VG/PG base e-liquid mix Made in the UK
